_readme: Each entry maps an activity_id or category to a scientifically sourced impact factor. This file intentionally starts EMPTY of numeric factors: SPRING will not invent environmental savings numbers. To enable numeric impact calculation for an activity, add an entry here with a real source/year/uncertainty, for example: { "activity_id": "reusable_bottle", "category": "plastic", "unit_of_action": "bottle", "impact_factor": 12, "impact_factor_unit": "g_plastic_avoided_per_use", "uncertainty": 3, "impact_factor_source": "<cite the specific study/report here>", "impact_factor_year": 2024, "geographic_scope": "global", "methodology": "<describe>" }. Until an entry exists for a given activity/category, the engine reports NOT_SCIENTIFICALLY_CALCULABLE for it instead of guessing.
